## Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR #170, exact head `b69cf96b6a6b6e9938f40a35f66ba66113fb4f52`.

Reviewed `a0967ab..b69cf96` and dependent preflight/removal ordering. No new high-confidence security vulnerability was identified. The four stderr guards strengthen refusal/spare behavior without expanding deletion policy.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No new vulnerability identified | - |

### Guard evidence

- Worktree-inventory stderr refuses the whole run before parsing/removal (`harness/scripts/pr-freeze.ts:687`).
- Seat-inventory stderr likewise refuses globally (`pr-freeze.ts:598`).
- PR stderr caches an unavailable verdict, sparing that PR's candidates (`pr-freeze.ts:706-710`).
- Status stderr spares the candidate, including exit-zero/empty-stdout warnings (`pr-freeze.ts:724-731`).

Whitespace-only stderr is ignored via trimming. Warnings are handled before permissive parsing or candidate verdict creation. Decisions precede removal; spared candidates are not later reconsidered through cached results. These are safety brakes, not new removal permissions.

Argv-only execution, absolute tool paths, strict macOS lsof observation, unsupported-platform refusal and Git removal without force remain intact. No C19/C21 or payload/privacy regression was identified.

### Proof limits

No-removal assertions appear in `harness/scripts/pr-freeze.test.ts:741,745,753`. The warned-seat fixture also returns malformed inventory (`:544`): its expected warning text distinguishes this guard, but a no-removal assertion alone would also pass under existing malformed-inventory rejection. Reported mutation kills were not independently repeated.

Own-user-only visibility and snapshot-to-deletion races remain documented limitations; this delta does not establish machine-wide occupancy or lock a candidate against later use.

GitHub metadata and the independent remote pull ref agree on the full reviewed SHA; GitHub reports CLEAN. CI run `42433237523` and latest successful Delivers run `42433238035` both identify this SHA and success. The earlier cancelled Delivers run is superseded.

No local builds, tests, mutation checks, process probes, prune execution, credential reads or deletions were performed.
